content.thinking:
I'm checking the claims against the source. The outage left some shoppers unable to open their account pages for at least 20 minutes and 12 seconds, and the worst minute had a high share of failing requests. The trigger was a new monthly-spending feature switched on for those pages, and the feature is what I'm looking at next.

I'm going through the remaining claims one at a time. The feature's failing calculation hits shoppers with no purchases this month, and the ones affected are likely people who bought before but not recently. The loss estimate and the no-paging point both check out, and the rollback that didn't help and the draft fix are also supported by the record.

content.text: Every claim in the overview matches the record, so I found nothing to flag.

supported.quote: For {duration}, some shoppers on io-shop could not open their account pages.
rows: What a reader saw: Shoppers' account pages failed to load
How long it lasted: at least 20m 12s {duration}

supported.quote: The trouble started when a new monthly-spending feature was switched on for the account pages.
The feature runs a calculation that fails for any shopper with no purchases in the current month, so their account pages would not load.
The shoppers affected were likely those who have bought from the shop before but not this month.
Argus estimates the shop lost {customer_loss} in takings.
